description: This file contains Kotlin code defining data classes, enums, and functions for configuring and validating gateway connections within an Android application. It handles parsing URLs, decoding setup codes, constructing configuration objects, and providing validation messaging related to gateway endpoints and setup procedures.

classes.name: GatewayEndpointConfig
classes.description: Configuration details for a gateway endpoint, including host, port, TLS setting, and display URL.

classes.name: GatewaySetupCode
classes.description: Data class representing a setup code payload including URL and optional tokens/passwords.

classes.name: GatewayConnectConfig
classes.description: Configuration for establishing a connection to a gateway, including authentication tokens and host details.

classes.name: GatewayEndpointValidationError
classes.description: Enum class indicating possible validation errors for a gateway endpoint URL.

classes.name: GatewayEndpointInputSource
classes.description: Enum class indicating the source of gateway endpoint input (setup code, manual, QR scan).

classes.name: GatewayEndpointParseResult
classes.description: Result of parsing a gateway endpoint URL, including optional config or error.

classes.name: GatewayScannedSetupCodeResult
classes.description: Result of scanning a setup code, containing optional setup code string or error.

methods.name: resolveGatewayConnectConfig
methods.description: Constructs a GatewayConnectConfig object based on user input or saved settings, handling setup code decoding and URL parsing.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpoint
methods.description: Parses a raw gateway URL string into a GatewayEndpointConfig object.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointResult
methods.description: Parses a raw URL string into a GatewayEndpointParseResult, performing validation and URL normalization.

methods.name: decodeGatewaySetupCode
methods.description: Decodes a Base64-encoded setup code JSON string into a GatewaySetupCode object.

methods.name: resolveScannedSetupCode
methods.description: Extracts a setup code string from raw input, then decodes and validates it.

methods.name: resolveScannedSetupCodeResult
methods.description: Performs detailed decoding and validation of a scanned setup code.

methods.name: gatewayEndpointValidationMessage
methods.description: Generates user-friendly validation messages based on error type and input source.

methods.name: composeGatewayManualUrl
methods.description: Creates a manual URL string for gateway connection based on host, port, and TLS boolean.
